user.title: Connect to Swiggy MCP Bridge
user.description: Enter the Swiggy MCP Bridge add-on's internal address: http://<hostname>:8099, where <hostname> is shown on the add-on's Info tab (Settings → Apps → Swiggy MCP Bridge). The add-on must be installed and running.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the add-on at that URL. Check it's running and that the hostname matches its Info tab.

add_to_cart.name: Add to Instamart cart
add_to_cart.description: Adds an item to the Instamart cart via the Swiggy MCP Bridge add-on.

item_id.name: Item ID
item_id.description: Product ID from Instamart (in demo mode: demo-milk, demo-bread, demo-eggs or demo-bananas).
